Plugin.BrowserSearch.Name: Browser Search
Plugin.BrowserSearch.Description: Search Chrome, Edge, and Firefox bookmarks and history
Plugin.BrowserSearch.Setting.ChromeEnabl: Include Google Chrome bookmarks and history.
Plugin.BrowserSearch.Setting.EdgeEnabled: Include Microsoft Edge bookmarks and history.
Plugin.BrowserSearch.Setting.SearchBookm: Include browser bookmarks in search results.
Plugin.BrowserSearch.Setting.SearchHisto: Include browsing history in search results.
Plugin.BrowserSearch.Setting.ChromeUserD: Leave empty for the default Chrome User Data folder. Point this at User Data to scan every person, or at a profile folder such as Default or Profile 1.
Plugin.BrowserSearch.Setting.ChromeProfi: Optional profile folder or person name (Default, Profile 1, or the name shown in Chrome). Empty searches all profiles under the user data folder.
Plugin.BrowserSearch.Setting.EdgeUserDat: Leave empty for the default Edge User Data folder. Point this at User Data to scan every person, or at a profile folder such as Default or Profile 1.
Plugin.BrowserSearch.Setting.EdgeProfile: Optional profile folder or person name (Default, Profile 1, or the name shown in Edge). Empty searches all profiles under the user data folder.
Plugin.BrowserSearch.Setting.FirefoxProf: Leave empty for the default Firefox folder. Point this at the Firefox directory, the Profiles directory, or a single profile folder that contains places.sqlite.
Optional Firefox profile name or folder. Empty searches all profiles.
Plugin.BrowserSearch.Result.Subtitle: {{browser}} · {{kind}} · {{location}}
Plugin.BrowserSearch.Action.OpenDescript: Open this URL in the default browser
Plugin.BrowserSearch.Action.CopyUrlDescr: Copy this URL to the clipboard
